subject: Post-demo: Draft Sprint Plan for 1-Month Validation (action items & KPI checklist)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@clarityworks.com>, Michael Brenner <michael.brenner@clarityworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T22:14:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Draft Sprint Plan for 1-Month Validation (action items & KPI checklist)

Hi Dana / Michael —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a concrete proposal for a compact validation (4 weeks) so your engineering and procurement teams can evaluate risk, cost, and integration effort.

High-level proposal (4-week trial)
- Week 0 (kickoff): data access, test keys, VPC peering / sample dataset ingest
- Week 1: integration + baseline runs (50k sample tokens), latency & token-cost profiling
- Week 2: quality evaluation against your canonical prompt set; automated regression tests
- Week 3: performance tuning (batching, KV cache), run production-like load tests
- Week 4: acceptance, handoff, summary report + recommended production config

Proposed success criteria (any two of the following must be met)
- Response quality: defined by your F1/accuracy on the 500-record prompt set (target >= 92%)
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 350ms for 512-token queries under target throughput
- Cost: per-1k-token cost within agreed threshold (we'll quantify once we have sample data)
- Reliability: <1% error rate over a 24h load test

Ownership
- Redwood AE (Jordan Blake) — program lead, kickoff, and exec updates
- Redwood SE (Ben Carter) — integration, tuning, runbook
- Redwood CS (Monica Patel) — success criteria validation, acceptance report
- ClarityWorks Eng (Michael) — data access and integration owner
- ClarityWorks PM (Dana) — business acceptance and procurement

Attachments: clarity-poc-scope.xlsx (scope and sample checklist)

Next steps
1) Please confirm you can commit to a kickoff window the week of Sep 6–10. I propose Sep 7 at 10am PT for a 60-minute kickoff.
2) Share the sample dataset and a point-of-contact for secure credential exchange
3) Let us know any non-negotiable acceptance criteria beyond what I listed

If you prefer a 5-week window instead of 4, we can stretch the tuning runway — happy to adapt.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Draft Sprint Plan for 1-Month Validation (action items & KPI checklist)

Jordan — thanks for the detailed plan, this is helpful.
A few clarifying questions before I confirm the kickoff:

- Data & compliance: we need to be sure the trial environment conforms to SOC 2 and that PII is masked before sending. Can you confirm what controls you expect on our side and what Redwood manages?
- Trial environment: is the proposed run in a Redwood-hosted sandbox or in our VPC (we prefer VPC for PHI-like data)?
- Success criteria: can you translate the 'Response quality' metric to the exact scoring script you plan to run? Our QA wants the exact thresholds and any sampling logic.
- Procurement: our procurement lead (cc'd Michael) needs a ballpark cost estimate for the 4-week run so finance can greenlight.

We are tentatively available for Sep 7 but would prefer Sep 8 at 11am ET if that works. Please share the kickoff invite and the runbook you mentioned.

Thanks — Dana

Dana Ortiz
Director, Product | ClarityWorks
dana.ortiz@clarityworks.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@clarityworks.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Brenner <michael.brenner@clarityworks.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T12:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Draft Sprint Plan for 1-Month Validation (action items & KPI checklist)

Hi Dana —

Great questions. Quick answers below (technical + security):

- Controls / SOC2: Redwood's hosted trial environment runs in a SOC 2 Type II compliant cluster. For VPC trials we provide a private control plane and you retain infrastructure control; network/VPC peering and customer-managed KMS are supported. If you plan to send unmasked PII/PHI we strongly recommend VPC + KMS (Redwood will not persist raw PII in hosted sandboxes without explicit agreement).

- Trial environment options:
  * Hosted sandbox (quickest): fast to spin up, SOC2 controls, but Redwood manages infra and logs
  * VPC/private trial (recommended for PHI): we deploy inference nodes in your VPC; you retain keys and access

- Scoring script / response quality: we'll run your canonical 500-record prompt set through our eval harness. The script computes token-level F1 and a binary acceptance metric (pass if >= 92% on the accepted prompts). I'll attach the scoring.yaml we use for transparency — it's the same harness we showed today.

- Ballpark cost: rough estimate for a 4-week VPC trial with a small GPU pool to simulate production is ~$12k–18k (depends on throughput targets). Hosted sandbox is typically lower (~$6k–9k). Ben will work with finance to provide a firm quote once we have sample throughput and retention windows.

Attachments: redwood_trial_runbook.pdf, scoring-harness.yaml

If Sep 8, 11am ET works for you, we'll send the calendar invite and pre-kickoff checklist. Also Jordan / Monica — I'll take point on the runbook and scoring artifact delivery.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Draft Sprint Plan for 1-Month Validation (action items & KPI checklist)

Thanks everyone — good thread.

Dana — Sep 8, 11am ET works for us. I've locked that in and sent a calendar invite with a tentative agenda (kickoff, security checklist, data handoff steps, success criteria sign-off). Zoom link is in the invite.

Consolidated next actions before kickoff (owner / due)
- ClarityWorks: share sample dataset + POC contact for credential exchange (Dana / Michael) — due Sep 3
- Redwood (Ben): deliver scoring-harness.yaml and redwood_trial_runbook.pdf — due Sep 3 (attached here again)
- Redwood (Jordan): draft SOW & ballpark quote for 4-week VPC trial — due Sep 4
- Redwood CS (Monica): draft acceptance report template and KPI dashboard links — due Sep 10

Finalized success gates (we will record in the SOW):
1) >= 92% acceptance on canonical prompt set (500 records)
2) p95 latency <= 350ms at target throughput
3) <1% error rate during 24h stability run

Attachments (re-attached): redwood_trial_runbook.pdf, clarity-poc-scope.xlsx, scoring-harness.yaml
Related links: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CLW-2026-021, Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExample

If anything here looks off, reply-all and I'll update the invite/SOW accordingly.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
